title: Not Just an Evaluation: A Case Study of Discourse Particle Sensitivity in Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.13794v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Discourse particles subtly shape the flow of discourse by reflecting conversational context and interlocutor attitudes, often leaving the truth-conditional meaning untouched. They are also often polyfunctional, with distinct senses which partially overlap with other particles; for example, the exclusive use of English "just" and "only" ("John only/just drinks water"). Despite the frequency of these words in natural language, they have gone largely unstudied due to the subtle nature of their effects. We investigate LLM sensitivity to "just" and "only" in natural conversations using behavioral and mechanistic analyses. First, we find that LLMs and humans similarly prefer the presence of these particles in context, and both are more sensitive to "just" compared to "only". translated_title: 不仅仅是评估：语言模型对话语助词敏感性的案例研究
translated_abstract: 话语助词通过反映会话语境和对话者态度，微妙地塑造着话语的流向，同时往往不改变其真值条件意义。这些词还常常具有多种功能，其不同义项与其他助词的意义部分重叠；例如英语中"just"和"only"的排他性用法（"John only/just drinks water"）。尽管这些词在自然语言中出现频率很高，但由于其效果的微妙性质，它们在很大程度上尚未被研究。我们采用行为分析和机制分析相结合的方法，研究了大语言模型在自然对话中对"just"和"only"的敏感性。首先，我们发现大语言模型与人类相似，都偏好语境中这些助词的存在，且两者对"just"都比"only"更为敏感。其次，在从带有和不带这些助词的大语言模型中进行采样时，我们发现大语言模型在给定其来源语境的情况下，始终将生成内容评为更可能……
tldr: 本研究通过行为与机制双重分析，首次揭示大语言模型与人类相似地偏好话语助词"just"和"only"的出现，且对"just"比"only"更敏感，展现了语言模型对话语中细微语义线索的敏感性。
